title: Chapter 141 Entering The City
content:
Chapter 141 Entering The City

"Drive, drive!"

With a shout from the driver, the whip was raised, and it was whipped on the remaining horses. The speed of the horses increased rapidly, and they ran towards the distance.

"My lord, this time we have dealt with the Mo family and the Yin-Yang family, these two great rivers and lakes schools, and let the three elders of the Yin-Yang family escape. Will there be any disaster?" Said to Zhong Yu.

"Don't worry, nothing will happen. No one else knows about this operation except us and the Yin-Yang School. And the Yin-Yang School and the Moh School and other schools of the Six Kingdoms are enemies of life and death. Even if they tell us about our existence and accuse us We did it. Others won't believe it, even if they have doubts in their hearts, they won't say it face to face, they will only investigate secretly." Zhong Yu looked very relaxed and didn't have any worries about this action.

"That's right, let me tell you, even if someone else finds out, so what, the Zhangba Snake Spear in Zhang Fei's hand is not a vegetarian, and I have long been itchy and want to compete with the masters of the six countries!" Zhang Fei said with a smile, he had been shooting arrows just now, and there was no violent hand-to-hand combat, which aroused the desire to fight in his heart and never subsided.

"Yide is right. With our current strength, plus I have seven of his fourth ranks, plus a group of hidden guards, we are not weaker than those so-called university schools in the Jianghu." Zhong Yu seemed extremely confident, because the strength of the guards accompanying him was comparable to that of some elementary schools in Baijia.

"It's absolutely impossible for those people to surround and kill me without gathering the strength of their entire school, after careful consideration and careful planning."

"And we have initially established an intelligence system in the six countries. Seven hundred households of secret guards are distributed in the seven countries. Those forces in the rivers and lakes, the forces of various countries, want to be against me, and they will sooner or later I received the news from the hidden guards, and prepared in advance!" Speaking of this, I couldn't help but feel very proud, I had already arranged many dark guards with the foresight to inquire about the information of the Seven Kingdoms for myself.

"Then my lord, what are we going to do in the capital of Yan Kingdom?" Dian Wei, who was not very bright, asked in a daze.

"What are you going to do? Of course, to see what kind of existence our next opponent, Yan Guo, is." Zhong Yulang laughed, and suddenly, something flashed in his mind, as if he had thought of something. "By the way, I almost forgot about it. At this time, in the capital city of Yan Kingdom, there seems to be a dance hall called Feixue Pavilion, which has a dance master who is number one in the world. You must visit it when you get there."

"Really? To be called the world's first dance master by the lord, we all feel a little itchy. We can't wait to see who it is, who deserves the lord's praise!" Zhang Fei said with a loud voice , Zhang Fei looks reckless, but he likes to be arty, and he can't help being fascinated when he hears a dance master.

"No. 1 in the world, maybe she is! But besides dancing, she is also very good at other things!" Zhong Yu replied irrelevantly, as if she had some meaning.

After finishing speaking, Zhong Yu whipped his horsewhip and galloped towards the capital city of Yan Kingdom first. He couldn't wait to see this majestic ancient city that had been passed down to him for 800 years.

Two hours later, it was already dusk, and when the sun set on the western mountain, a group of people arrived at the gate of the capital of Yan Kingdom.

At this time in the capital city, although it was almost dark, there were still people coming and going at the gate of the city, and there was a constant flow of cars and horses. Hundreds of people lined up, one by one, waiting to enter the city, but at the gate of the city, the defenders made things difficult for them because of how much the entrance fee was, and they started arguing, which directly delayed the speed of the entire people's entry into the city.

However, as the master of millions of people, Zhong Yu, the emperor of Yuguo. Naturally, it is impossible to crowd the city gate with a group of what he considers to be untouchables. Even if he was willing, Zhao Yun and his subordinates would not allow it. Zhong Yu's demeaning behavior would make them feel ashamed.

Moreover, those city gate guards didn't dare to let Zhong Yu, who seemed to be very powerful at first glance, go to squeeze the city gate with a group of small people, and a few clever soldiers came early to receive Zhong Yu and others.

"My lords, I don't know where you come from? What's your business in the city? If you tell me something small, maybe you can help some lords!" The soldier didn't dare to ask clearly, who are these people from? He could only turn around and ask.

"Hmph, where did we come from? Is it something you, a little soldier, can ask? Get out of the way quickly and let me wait to enter the city, which will delay our major event. Be careful that you will lose your life!" Zhang Fei glared angrily. , said in a rough voice.

Those few soldiers who were already terrified trembled and their legs went limp. If they hadn't supported each other, they might have knelt down early and begged for mercy.

The captain of the city gate behind those soldiers saw that something was wrong in front of them. It seemed that those unknown visitors who were dressed in gorgeous clothes and exuded dignity and majesty were a little uncomfortable to speak, so they could only hurry over and take the words of those soldiers. , Deal with these people who I can't afford.

"My lords, please calm down. These little ones haven't seen much in the world, so I hope you don't blame them. It's just my duty. It's my duty to ask people who enter the city. Please don't embarrass the villain? "After finishing speaking, the captain of the city gate arched his hands and bowed deeply.

"You..." Zhang Fei opened his mouth, as if he wanted to say something else.

"Okay, Yide, step back! People are also responsible, so it's okay to talk to them!" Zhong Yu didn't want to have any conflicts with the gate guards of Yan Kingdom in this place, so he chose to calm down and talk to them. It's okay to talk about it.

"General, we are some travelers from the south. We usually like to travel and study around the world. I heard that there is a world-renowned dance master in the country of Yan, so I came here to experience it. By the way, let's take a look at the characters of the country of Yan. Style, to increase our knowledge." Zhong Yu explained his purpose of coming here, but this is also his goal of coming out of Weifu, to play and see all the talents and heroes in the world, strange people and strange things.

The captain of the city gate looked at the people in front of him, each of them was dressed gorgeously, exuding the aura of being a superior. He had only seen it in the court and the high-ranking ministers, and he couldn't help guessing that the identities of these people in front of him must not be simple.

And hearing the explanation given by the person in front of him who seems to be the leader, I heard that the country of Yan has the best dancer in the world, and it must be the Snow Girl from Feixue Pavilion!

This is not bad, since Xue Nu came to Yan Kingdom, countless romantic talents, high-ranking officials and nobles from all over the world came to Yandu, just for the allure of Xue Nu.

Now these people in front of them are rich and noble, and they can be seen from extraordinary backgrounds. It is said that they are here for a study tour, I am afraid it is to see the elegant demeanor of Xuenv, and even hug the beauty back, so let's have a romantic affair with a gifted scholar and a beautiful woman!

Thinking of this, the captain of Chengmen smiled slightly, saluted with both hands, and signaled the soldiers behind to get out of the way: "Since the young master is studying somewhere, I dare not stop you, please!"
